periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the superior poles angled inward toward the sagittal plane and inferior poles tapering outward at approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio, appearing approximately twice as tall as they are wide.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering present, with the lower boundary of the patches forming a narrow terminal end below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a relatively flat profile across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending from the base of the neck to approximately the mid-thoracic region, occupying roughly 35-40% of the visible dorsal-lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large lateral separation with the ears positioned on the outer upper quadrants of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex semicircular curvature without visible flattening or notches at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow staining of the pelage on the lower abdomen and hind limbs, contrasting with the stark white fur of the head and upper chest.
